 Gift (Code) Received 2022/03/21 
 Nature
 One non-partisan paid intern from the Canadian Political Science Association began working in the office March 21, 2022 and will conclude on June 16, 2022. The interns also have numerous other obligations outside of their work-study placement in MP offices, including their research and seminars.
 Source
 Canadian Political Science Association
 Circumstances
 The ten interns interviewed and chose the MPs they will work with. The interns are university graduates and have received training from the House of Commons prior to starting work in the offices.
